title: incident-bot: SLO->Runbook autodiagnostics + on-call summary improvements
author: Avery Chen
description: This PR adds automatic SLO->Runbook linking and improved on-call summary diagnostics to the incident-bot. Motivation: reduce on-call MTTR by surfacing the most relevant runbooks and compact diagnostic summaries in the incident channel, and allow SLO context to be included in autodiagnostics triggers. Changes include: 1) new SLO ranker module that assigns confidence-weighted runbook suggestions based on recent alert fingerprint + SLO metadata, 2) compact runbook link blocks for Slack and MS Teams (short form + expand-on-click), 3) a new oncall-summary generator that produces a 3-line TL;DR plus actionable next steps, 4) CLI flags and config options in incident-bot.yaml to opt-in/out of autodiagnostics for specific services, 5) unit and integration tests for ranking heuristics and message formatting, 6) docs and runbook examples. Checklist: - [x] Add SLO ranker and heuristics - [x] Add compact runbook link block templates - [x] Implement oncall-summary generator and templates - [x] Add config/CLI switches - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Update docs and changelog - [x] CI green and merge via squashNotes: This is intended to be backward compatible; autodiagnostics are disabled by default and must be enabled per-team via config. The description includes example message payloads in the code comments for reviewers.
